title: 749. Prefix and Suffix Search

examples.explanation: Indices 0 and 2 fit; return the larger.

hints: Scanning indices from the end downward lets you return the first fit, which is automatically the largest.
A word fits when it starts with pref and ends with suff; both checks are linear in the word length.
For many repeated queries a combined prefix-suffix map or trie pays off, but a single scan is enough for one query.
